title: Testable Settings Singleton with Overrides
instructions: In `appsettings.py`, build a settings module that is convenient in production and harmless in tests: a pure `load_settings(env)`, a lazy thread-safe `get_settings()`, `reset_settings()`, an `override_settings(**changes)` context manager that restores the exact previous state, and a `BudgetGuard` that receives its `Settings` by injection.

evidence.label: load_settings applies defaults and parses values
load_settings reads only the mapping it is given
Bad budgets raise ValueError (the message names MONTHLY_BUDGET_USD)
Eight threads released together all get one Settings object
override_settings swaps values in and restores the exact previous object
The override is undone when the body raises
Unknown override fields raise TypeError and change nothing
BudgetGuard enforces the injected budget and refuses over-budget spend
